task: ae.parsegen grammar toolkit: FIRST/FOLLOW, LL(1)/SLR(1) generators and parsers, Earley oracle, differential tests
reasoning_summary: Built grammar analysis, LL(1) and SLR(1) table construction with structured conflicts, tree-building parsers, an Earley recogniser as independent oracle and sentence generators. Tests use dragon-book literals plus exhaustive and randomized cross-engine differentials (LL(1) vs SLR vs Earley error indexes on two equivalent grammars). 53 tests pass after fixing two test defects; a 15-mutant check killed 14 and the survivor led to a new test.
